text:
Xperi Corporation (NASDAQ:XPER) Has Decline in Shorts Posted by Jack Shaw on January 4, 2019 at 4:48 pm
The stock of Xperi Corporation (NASDAQ:XPER) registered a decrease of 8.11% in short interest. XPER’s total short interest was 4.40 million shares in January as published by FINRA. Its down 8.11% from 4.79 million shares, reported previously. With 400,300 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 11 days to cover their XPER’s short positions. The short interest to Xperi Corporation’s float is 9.13%.
The stock increased 4.16% or $0.77 during the last trading session, reaching $19.28. About 153,724 shares traded. Xperi Corporation (NASDAQ:XPER) has declined 9.95% since January 4, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 9.95% the S&P500.
Xperi Corporation, through its subsidiaries, creates, develops, and licenses audio, computational imaging, computer vision and semiconductor packaging, and interconnect technologies worldwide. The company has market cap of $933.50 million. The firm operates through two divisions, Product Licensing; and Semiconductor and IP Licensing. It currently has negative earnings. The Product Licensing segment licenses technologies related to audio, digital radio, and imaging solutions under the DTS, HD Radio, and FotoNation brands.
